slots.title: What's on this week
slots.caption:
Bank holiday weekend in the yard ☀️

🎧 Saturday - MY Presents: DJ Benzo. A journey through the decades, music you'll know, music you'll sing, music you'll dance to.

🎪 Bank holiday Sunday - Carnival in the Courtyard. An explosion of colour, House, RnB, Garage, Reggae, Disco and Jungle, plus the biggest singalong anthems from the 70s to today. 2pm til midnight.

Tables are available via www.merchantsyardleicester.co.uk

See you in the yard.
